caption:
For me, today marks ten years of remote work around the world! I was doing it *before* it was cool and/or required by lockdowns. 

It's been an eventful decade, where I stared at a laptop and ignored my surroundings in a lot of interesting places. I decided ten years was a big enough milestone to make a bit of a "my office" photo montage. 

Here's to the next ten years! 🍻

caption:
I was told by several people at the conference yesterday that as an AI builder, I really should try out the @waymo driverless AI taxis here. They’re hailed from an app like Uber, one picked me up off the street and dropped at the hotel. 

Worked great, way less chaotic than many Uber rides I’ve taken with humans (or if I drove myself…). A++ would robot again, let’s get these in Lisbon too! 🤖🚕

caption:
Chappie, 26/07/2015 - 14/08/2024 🐱

We adopted Chappie after Tanchira found her on the street in Bangkok, and she was a constant companion throughout the last extremely tumultuous decade of our lives, happily living in a half-dozen apartments across three countries 🇹🇭🇬🇧🇵🇹

She was by our side through multiple international moves, the pandemic, lockdowns, immigration drama, snowstorms, floods, droughts, political strife, illnesses, failed businesses and successful ones — one of the very few constants I could rely on in a world of change.

She was (mostly) a very good girl, and always the best of friends. 

The house is so empty without her.

RIP 😿
